# JackTrader

> JackTrader is an independent Binance referral partner. Each quarter, the first 15 new Binance users who sign up through a JackTrader invite get a $20 cash reward; traders with $50,000+ in funds get an above-market rebate rate quoted one-on-one; and every referred user can join a free Alpha members group that aggregates real-time alpha from major secondary-market communities. Not affiliated with Binance.

## Offer
- $20 cash for the first 15 new Binance users each quarter (sign up through a JackTrader invite); above-market rebate rates for $50K+ accounts, quoted one-on-one; a free Alpha members group for every referred user (information only, not investment advice).
- New-user reward: spots are limited and first-come, first-served; message https://t.me/Jack168668 to confirm how to claim. The rebate rate and payout method for $50K+ accounts are confirmed one-on-one.
- The $20 reward is for new Binance accounts (first 15 each quarter); existing accounts can be assessed for Binance's official rebind.
- Does not require asset transfer, private keys, seed phrases, or API permissions.
- Tokenized US stocks on Binance: buy with USDT, fractional shares, no wire transfer; the same new-user and $50K+ account offers apply when you sign up through JackTrader.
